description: Radial Network Graph is an interactive network diagram for Microsoft Power BI. Map the relationships, connections, and flows between people, systems, accounts, or locations: nodes sit on a ring grouped by category, joined by links weighted by value. Hover to trace a node's connections, click to cross-filter the report, and drill down through hierarchies inside the visual. A readable alternative to force-directed graphs and chord diagrams. Key Features Radial layout: nodes around a circle, sorted by group and size, with outward-reading labels, gaps between groups, and colored group arcs. No random force layout: the same data always draws the same ring. Weighted links: link width by value, adjustable curvature, and four color modes: fixed, source group, target group, or gradient. Directed networks: show arrowheads and keep A → B apart from B → A for payments, data flows, and dependencies. Neighborhood highlighting: hover a node to light up its links and neighbors while the rest of the network fades. In-visual drill-down: stack up to 9 fields (for example Region, Country, Entity) and click a node to expand its children in place. Back, Reset, and Expand all buttons, plus a configurable starting level. Cross-filtering: click a node, link, or legend group to filter the report; other visuals cross-highlight the network in return. Supports the context menu, bookmarks, and Ctrl + click…
